verdict.rationale: Docs show custom objects/fields (20+ field types, unlimited custom objects), table/kanban/calendar views with AND/OR filters, multi-field sort, grouping, and saved custom views — all configurable directly in the UI without admin/dev involvement. Community feedback corroborates customization is 'very promising' though the product overall was described as alpha-stage. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of 'sharing' a saved view with specific teammates/permissions (only workspace-level dashboard sharing is documented) and independent hands-on confirmation of view-building specifically.
